facts.text: I am a hypnotist and transformational/mindset coach.
I help female entrepreneurs discover what is holding them back in business.
I help female entrepreneurs overcome limiting beliefs, self-sabotage, blocks, and imposter syndrome.
I help female entrepreneurs achieve their business goals with confidence.
My target audience is female entrepreneurs.
My target audience suffers from something.
My target audience wants a solution to something.
I want to write an e-book that will be a lead magnet for my target audience.
The topic of my e-book is overcoming imposter syndrome.
I want the e-book to include the benefits of overcoming imposter syndrome.
I want the writing tone to be empathetic, friendly, playful, and humorous.
I want the writing style to be conversational and metaphorical and persuasive.
